# Colors and Motion Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Give the homepage the wine & cream + project-color palette, serif numbered sections, one-project-per-row work section, and the four chosen animations (name rise, tilt + glow, scroll color change, custom cursor).

**Architecture:** The pages are generated by `scripts/render-*.mjs` into `index.html` and `projects/*.html` (`npm run render`). Never hand-edit `index.html`. Colors live in `css/tokens.css`. The new interactive behavior lives in one new module, `js/showcase.js`, and the name-rise trigger lives in `js/motion.js`. Swarm signals its end with a `swarm-rebuild:end` DOM event from the adapter, `js/swarm-rebuild.js`.

**Tech Stack:** Static HTML/CSS, vanilla ES modules, `node --test` with hand-rolled fake DOM objects (see `test/motion.test.mjs` for the house style).

**Spec:** `docs/plans/2026-11-17-colors-and-motion-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Hero colors and layout unchanged in both themes (`--hero-*` tokens untouched).
- Project tones: SkyFire `#b4471a`, mAIstra `#1f5f70`, Bulk Buying `#4a7330`, Pulso `#2f5c94`, Sige `#946320`; text on tones `#fbf3ee`; wine `#3a1320` / dark `#22101a`.
- No tech-stack marquee.
- Tilt and cursor only under `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and never under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- Everything stays usable without JavaScript (static color bands, static name).
- Keep all existing test guarantees about content: 8 credential links with icons and type text, 5 previews with toggles, 3 phone frames, role after title, and so on.

## Review Focus

1. **Swarm running at load:** the name must be fully visible while Swarm snapshots the page, and it rises only after `swarm-rebuild:end`. Tested in Task 4.
2. **Swarm skipped (deep link `#work`, back/forward, scrolled page):** the name rise and the cursor still start. The adapter must dispatch the end event on release. Tested in Task 4.
3. **Reduced motion turned on:** no letter transforms, no tilt, no cursor, and the project rows show static bands. Tested in Tasks 4 and 5.
4. **Touch or coarse pointer:** the cursor is never created and the native cursor is never hidden. Tested in Task 5.
5. **Bubble label over the preview video:** it says "Play" or "Pause" to match `video.paused`, never "View". Tested in Task 5.

### Task 4: Swarm end signal and the name rise

**Files:**
- Modify: `js/swarm-rebuild.js`, `scripts/render-swarm-rebuild.mjs`, `scripts/render-hero-composition.mjs`, `css/hero.css`, `js/motion.js`
- Test: `test/swarm-rebuild.test.mjs`, `test/motion.test.mjs`, `test/home-render.test.mjs`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: the DOM event `swarm-rebuild:end`, dispatched once on `root` (the document). `initNameRise(root = document): () => void` is exported from `js/motion.js`, and `afterSwarm(doc, fn): () => void` is exported from `js/motion.js` for Task 5. Letters render as `<span class="hero-letter" style="--i:N">X</span>`, with N continuing across both lines.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests.**
  - swarm: in each "preserves direct navigation" case, the fake root's `dispatchEvent` receives exactly one `swarm-rebuild:end`. When the load succeeds and `view.__swarmRebuild.app` becomes null, the next interval tick dispatches it once. On load failure it is dispatched once. `renderSwarmBootstrap()` contains `nameRise='play'` in the branch where Swarm is skipped.
  - motion: `initNameRise` with `dataset.swarmBuild='pending'` does not set `dataset.nameRise` until the `swarm-rebuild:end` listener fires, then it equals `'play'`. With no swarmBuild, it sets `'play'` immediately. With reduced motion, it never sets it.
  - home-render: the h1 keeps `aria-label="Jayrald Tajanlangit"`, there are 18 `hero-letter` spans, and `--i:17` is the last.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run `npm test`. Expected: FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Implement.
  - Adapter: a guarded `end()` dispatches `new view.CustomEvent('swarm-rebuild:end')` only when `root.dispatchEvent` is a function. Call it from every `release()` path. After `load()`, poll `view.setInterval(…, 200)` until `!view.__swarmRebuild?.app`, then call `end()`. The cleanup function clears the interval.
  - Bootstrap: add `else if(!reduced) r.dataset.nameRise='play'`.
  - CSS: replace the `hero-name-arrive` word animation with `html[data-name-rise="play"] .hero-letter { animation: hero-letter-rise 900ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) calc(var(--i) * 45ms) both }` (from `translateY(105%)`) and `html[data-name-rise="play"] .hero-portrait { animation: hero-portrait-rise 1000ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) 450ms both }` (from opacity 0, translate y 24px). Keep the existing `-50%` x translate inside both keyframes. Put everything inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
  - `motion.js`: remove `.hero-composition` from the entrance selector, and call `initNameRise` from `initPageMotion`.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Run `npm test`. Expected: all pass.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `feat: letter-by-letter name rise after Swarm`.

### Task 5: Showcase module (color change, tilt, cursor)

**Files:**
- Create: `js/showcase.js`, `test/showcase.test.mjs`
- Modify: `css/selected-work.css` (tilt, glare, glow, active-project backgrounds), `css/motion.css` (cursor), `scripts/render-home.mjs` (add `<script type="module" src="js/showcase.js">` after `motion.js`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `afterSwarm` from `js/motion.js` (Task 4), plus Task 3's markup attributes.
- Produces: `initProjectColors(root): () => void`, `initProjectTilt(root): () => void`, `initViewCursor(root): () => void`, `cursorLabel(target): string | null`, `tiltFor(x, y): { rx: number, ry: number }` (x and y in 0..1, max 7°).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** (fake DOM in house style).
  - `tiltFor(.5,.5)` gives `{rx:0, ry:0}`; `tiltFor(1,0)` gives `{rx:7, ry:7}` (signs as implemented, magnitude 7); `tiltFor(0,1)` gives the inverse.
  - `cursorLabel`: an element inside `[data-cursor="View"]` gives `"View"`, a paused video gives `"Play"`, a playing video gives `"Pause"`, and a plain div gives `null`.
  - `initProjectColors`: when the observer callback reports the mAIstra article as intersecting, `section.dataset.activeProject === 'maistra'`; when it reports the section header, the value is `'intro'`; with reduced motion, no observer is created and `html` gets no `project-colors` class.
  - `initViewCursor` with `(pointer: fine)` false creates no element and adds no `custom-cursor` class to `html`. With it true, it appends one `aria-hidden` element after `afterSwarm` runs, and cleanup removes it.
  - `initProjectTilt` with a coarse pointer adds no listeners.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run `node --test test/showcase.test.mjs`. Expected: FAIL.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Implement.
  - Colors: when enhanced, `html.project-colors` makes the article bands transparent and `.work-section[data-active-project=<slug>]` sets `background-color: var(--tone-<slug>)` with a 700ms transition. The observer uses `rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px'` and watches the articles plus the section's `.section-heading`.
  - Tilt: on `pointermove`, rAF-batch the `--rx`/`--ry`/`--gx`/`--gy` properties on `[data-tilt]`. The CSS transform is `perspective(900px) rotateX(var(--rx)) rotateY(var(--ry))`. A `::after` glare uses a radial gradient at `--gx --gy`, and hover adds `box-shadow: 0 0 48px var(--glow-<slug>)`. Reset on leave.
  - Cursor: `.cursor-dot` is 12px and becomes 72px as a labelled bubble. It is burgundy, or `#fbf3ee` when the target is inside `[data-surface="dark"]` or the theme is dark. Lerp 0.22 in rAF while moving. Grow to 28px over `a, button`. `html.custom-cursor * { cursor: none }`. Hide the dot when the pointer leaves the document.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Run `npm test`. Expected: all pass.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `feat: project color scroll, media tilt and view cursor`.
